# CLR source-support helper functions 
```{r}
extract_date_from_name_int <- function(x) {
  m <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{8}")
  as.Date(m, format = "%Y%m%d")
}

extract_ptrap_from_name_int <- function(x) {
  out <- stringr::str_match(x, "PTW_[A-Za-z]+([123])_")[, 2]
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(out))
}

ra_tbl_to_mat_int <- function(ra_tbl, id_cols = c("Sequence", "Taxon", "id", "Consensus")) {
  id_cols <- intersect(id_cols, colnames(ra_tbl))
  sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(ra_tbl), id_cols)
  ra_mat <- as.matrix(ra_tbl[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(ra_mat) <- "double"
  list(
    ra_mat = ra_mat,
    feature_meta = ra_tbl[, id_cols, drop = FALSE],
    sample_cols = sample_cols
  )
}

clr_tbl_to_mat_int <- function(clr_tbl, id_cols = c("Sequence", "Taxon", "id", "Consensus")) {
  id_cols <- intersect(id_cols, colnames(clr_tbl))
  sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(clr_tbl), id_cols)
  clr_mat <- as.matrix(clr_tbl[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(clr_mat) <- "double"
  list(
    clr_mat = clr_mat,
    feature_meta = clr_tbl[, id_cols, drop = FALSE],
    sample_cols = sample_cols
  )
}

to_relative_abundance <- function(df, id_cols = c("Sequence", "Taxon", "id", "Consensus")) {
  count_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), id_cols)
  counts <- df[count_cols]
  col_totals <- colSums(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
  col_totals[col_totals == 0] <- NA_real_
  ra <- sweep(counts, 2, col_totals, FUN = "/")
  ra[is.na(ra)] <- 0
  data.frame(df[id_cols], ra, check.names = FALSE)
}

to_clr <- function(ra_df, id_cols = c("Sequence", "Taxon", "id", "Consensus"), pseudo = NULL) {
  count_cols <- setdiff(colnames(ra_df), id_cols)
  mat <- as.matrix(ra_df[, count_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(mat) <- "double"
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  if (is.null(pseudo)) {
    min_pos <- suppressWarnings(min(mat[mat > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    pseudo <- if (is.finite(min_pos)) min_pos / 2 else 1e-6
  }
  mat[mat == 0] <- pseudo
  clr_mat <- sweep(log(mat), 2, colMeans(log(mat)), FUN = "-")
  data.frame(ra_df[id_cols], clr_mat, check.names = FALSE)
}

compare_numeric_summaries <- function(all_tbl, hc_tbl, key_cols) {
  common_keys <- intersect(names(all_tbl), names(hc_tbl))
  key_cols <- intersect(key_cols, common_keys)
  value_cols <- setdiff(common_keys, key_cols)

  all_long <- all_tbl %>%
    mutate(dataset = "35_all") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(value_cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

  hc_long <- hc_tbl %>%
    mutate(dataset = "35_hc") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(value_cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

  bind_rows(all_long, hc_long) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(delta_hc_minus_all = `35_hc` - `35_all`)
}


make_feature_key_int <- function(feature_meta,
                                 preferred_cols = c("Sequence", "id", "Taxon", "Consensus")) {
  use_cols <- intersect(preferred_cols, colnames(feature_meta))
  if (length(use_cols) == 0) {
    return(as.character(seq_len(nrow(feature_meta))))
  }
  do.call(paste, c(feature_meta[, use_cols, drop = FALSE], sep = "||"))
}

filter_features_for_clr_source <- function(ra_mat,
                                           min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                           min_mean_abundance = 1e-4) {
  prevalence <- rowMeans(ra_mat > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_abund <- rowMeans(ra_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep <- prevalence >= min_prevalence | mean_abund >= min_mean_abundance
  if (sum(keep) < 10) {
    warning("Too few features after filtering; returning original feature set.")
    return(rep(TRUE, nrow(ra_mat)))
  }
  keep
}

make_clr_profile <- function(clr_mat, sample_names, summary_fun = c("median", "mean")) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  sample_names <- intersect(sample_names, colnames(clr_mat))
  if (length(sample_names) == 0) return(NULL)

  vals <- clr_mat[, sample_names, drop = FALSE]
  prof <- if (summary_fun == "median") {
    apply(vals, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    rowMeans(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  prof[is.na(prof)] <- 0
  prof
}

fit_simplex_mixture_clr <- function(y,
                                    X,
                                    lambda_ridge = 0) {
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "double"

  k <- ncol(X)
  stopifnot(k >= 1L)

  softmax <- function(z) {
    z <- z - max(z)
    ez <- exp(z)
    ez / sum(ez)
  }

  obj_fun <- function(theta) {
    w <- softmax(theta)
    yhat_num <- drop(X %*% w)
    sse <- sum((y - yhat_num)^2)
    ridge <- lambda_ridge * sum(w^2)
    sse + ridge
  }

  init <- rep(0, k)
  fit <- optim(init, obj_fun, method = "BFGS", control = list(maxit = 5000))

  w <- softmax(fit$par)
  yhat_num <- drop(X %*% w)

  sse <- sum((y - yhat_num)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((y - yhat_num)^2))
  sst <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  r2 <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(sst, 0))) NA_real_ else 1 - sse / sst
  cosine <- sum(y * yhat_num) / sqrt(sum(y^2) * sum(yhat_num^2))
  err_vec_num <- (y - yhat_num)^2

  tibble::tibble(
    weight = list(w),
    fit_sse = sse,
    fit_rmse = rmse,
    fit_r2 = r2,
    fit_cosine = cosine,
    converged = isTRUE(fit$convergence == 0),
    yhat = list(yhat_num),
    err_vec = list(err_vec_num)
  )
}

subset_key_int <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) return(".EMPTY.")
  paste(x, collapse = "|")
}

all_subsets_int <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x)
  out <- list(character(0))
  if (length(x) == 0) return(out)
  for (k in seq_along(x)) {
    out <- c(out, combn(x, k, simplify = FALSE))
  }
  out
}

fit_subset_model_clr <- function(y,
                                 profiles,
                                 use_sources,
                                 lambda_ridge = 0) {
  use_sources <- intersect(use_sources, names(profiles))
  y <- as.numeric(y)

  if (length(use_sources) == 0) {
    yhat0 <- rep(mean(y), length(y))
    sse0 <- sum((y - yhat0)^2)
    rmse0 <- sqrt(mean((y - yhat0)^2))
    sst0 <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
    r20 <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(sst0, 0))) NA_real_ else 1 - sse0 / sst0
    cos0 <- sum(y * yhat0) / sqrt(sum(y^2) * sum(yhat0^2))

    return(tibble::tibble(
      fit_sse = sse0,
      fit_rmse = rmse0,
      fit_r2 = r20,
      fit_cosine = cos0,
      converged = TRUE,
      simplex_weight = list(setNames(numeric(0), character(0))),
      yhat = list(yhat0),
      err_vec = list((y - yhat0)^2)
    ))
  }

  X_list <- lapply(profiles[use_sources], function(z) {
    z_num <- as.numeric(z)
    if (!is.numeric(z_num)) {
      stop("Profile cannot be coerced to numeric.")
    }
    z_num
  })

  X <- do.call(cbind, X_list)
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "double"

  if (!is.numeric(y)) {
    stop("y is not numeric after coercion.")
  }
  if (!is.matrix(X)) {
    stop("X is not a matrix after coercion.")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(X)) {
    stop("X is not numeric after coercion.")
  }

  fit <- fit_simplex_mixture_clr(
    y = y,
    X = X,
    lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
  )

  w <- as.numeric(fit$weight[[1]])
  names(w) <- use_sources
  yhat_num <- as.numeric(fit$yhat[[1]])

  if (!is.numeric(yhat_num)) {
    stop("yhat is not numeric after coercion.")
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    fit_sse = as.numeric(fit$fit_sse[[1]]),
    fit_rmse = as.numeric(fit$fit_rmse[[1]]),
    fit_r2 = as.numeric(fit$fit_r2[[1]]),
    fit_cosine = as.numeric(fit$fit_cosine[[1]]),
    converged = isTRUE(fit$converged[[1]]),
    simplex_weight = list(w),
    yhat = list(yhat_num),
    err_vec = list(as.numeric((y - yhat_num)^2))
  )
}

empty_model_fit_int <- function(model_name,
                                all_sources = c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "Prev_PTW", "BLANK"),
                                y_len = NA_integer_) {
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    model = model_name,
    fit_sse = NA_real_,
    fit_rmse = NA_real_,
    fit_r2 = NA_real_,
    fit_cosine = NA_real_,
    converged = FALSE,
    n_sources_model = 0,
    yhat = list(if (is.na(y_len)) numeric(0) else rep(NA_real_, y_len)),
    err_vec = list(if (is.na(y_len)) numeric(0) else rep(NA_real_, y_len))
  )
  for (nm in all_sources) out[[nm]] <- 0
  out
}

fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr <- function(y,
                                              profiles,
                                              model_name,
                                              lambda_ridge = 0,
                                              all_sources = c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "Prev_PTW", "BLANK")) {
  available <- names(profiles)
  has_ext <- any(c("HW_prev", "TW_prev") %in% available)
  has_lag <- "Prev_PTW" %in% available

  if (model_name == "M_blank") {
    use_sources <- intersect(c("BLANK"), available)
    if (length(use_sources) == 0) return(empty_model_fit_int(model_name, all_sources, length(y)))
  } else if (model_name == "M_ext") {
    if (!has_ext) return(empty_model_fit_int(model_name, all_sources, length(y)))
    use_sources <- intersect(c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "BLANK"), available)
  } else if (model_name == "M_lag") {
    if (!has_lag) return(empty_model_fit_int(model_name, all_sources, length(y)))
    use_sources <- intersect(c("Prev_PTW", "BLANK"), available)
  } else if (model_name == "M_full") {
    if (!(has_ext && has_lag)) return(empty_model_fit_int(model_name, all_sources, length(y)))
    use_sources <- intersect(c("Prev_PTW", "HW_prev", "TW_prev", "BLANK"), available)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown model_name: ", model_name)
  }

  fit <- fit_subset_model_clr(
    y = y,
    profiles = profiles,
    use_sources = use_sources,
    lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
  )

  w <- fit$simplex_weight[[1]]
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    model = model_name,
    fit_sse = fit$fit_sse[[1]],
    fit_rmse = fit$fit_rmse[[1]],
    fit_r2 = fit$fit_r2[[1]],
    fit_cosine = fit$fit_cosine[[1]],
    converged = fit$converged[[1]],
    n_sources_model = length(use_sources),
    yhat = fit$yhat,
    err_vec = fit$err_vec
  )
  for (nm in all_sources) out[[nm]] <- 0
  if (length(w) > 0) {
    for (nm in names(w)) out[[nm]] <- unname(w[[nm]])
  }
  out %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(all_sources), dplyr::everything())
}

compute_shapley_explanatory_weights_clr <- function(y,
                                                    profiles,
                                                    lambda_ridge = 0,
                                                    source_order = c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "Prev_PTW", "BLANK"),
                                                    value_col = c("fit_r2", "fit_cosine"),
                                                    truncate_negative = TRUE) {
  value_col <- match.arg(value_col)

  src <- intersect(source_order, names(profiles))

  out0 <- tibble(
    source = source_order,
    available = source_order %in% src,
    shapley_value = 0,
    explanatory_weight = 0
  )

  if (length(src) == 0) {
    return(out0)
  }

  # 先算所有 subset 的 value function
  subset_list <- all_subsets_int(src)

  subset_vals <- purrr::map_dbl(subset_list, function(S) {
    fit <- fit_subset_model_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      use_sources = S,
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )
    val <- fit[[value_col]][[1]]
    if (is.na(val)) val <- 0
    if (isTRUE(truncate_negative)) val <- max(0, val)
    val
  })

  subset_keys <- purrr::map_chr(subset_list, subset_key_int)
  value_map <- stats::setNames(subset_vals, subset_keys)

  n <- length(src)
  fact_n <- factorial(n)

  shap <- stats::setNames(rep(0, n), src)

  for (i in src) {
    others <- setdiff(src, i)
    subsets_others <- all_subsets_int(others)

    for (S in subsets_others) {
      k <- length(S)
      coeff <- factorial(k) * factorial(n - k - 1) / fact_n

      key_S <- subset_key_int(S)
      key_Si <- subset_key_int(c(S, i))

      v_S <- value_map[[key_S]]
      v_Si <- value_map[[key_Si]]

      shap[[i]] <- shap[[i]] + coeff * (v_Si - v_S)
    }
  }

  shap_pos <- pmax(shap, 0)
  denom <- sum(shap_pos)

  if (denom <= 0) {
    fit_full <- fit_subset_model_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      use_sources = src,
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )
    w_raw <- fit_full$simplex_weight[[1]]

    expl <- rep(0, length(src))
    names(expl) <- src

    if (length(w_raw) > 0 && sum(w_raw) > 0) {
      expl[names(w_raw)] <- w_raw / sum(w_raw)
    }
  } else {
    expl <- shap_pos / denom
  }

  out <- out0
  out$shapley_value[match(src, out$source)] <- unname(shap)
  out$explanatory_weight[match(src, out$source)] <- unname(expl)

  out
}

collapse_explanatory_groups_int <- function(expl_tbl) {
  tibble(
    blank_support = sum(expl_tbl$explanatory_weight[expl_tbl$source == "BLANK"], na.rm = TRUE),
    lag_support = sum(expl_tbl$explanatory_weight[expl_tbl$source == "Prev_PTW"], na.rm = TRUE),
    external_support = sum(expl_tbl$explanatory_weight[expl_tbl$source %in% c("HW_prev", "TW_prev")], na.rm = TRUE),
    hw_within_external = {
      ext <- expl_tbl %>% filter(source %in% c("HW_prev", "TW_prev"))
      s <- sum(ext$explanatory_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (s > 0) sum(ext$explanatory_weight[ext$source == "HW_prev"], na.rm = TRUE) / s else NA_real_
    },
    tw_within_external = {
      ext <- expl_tbl %>% filter(source %in% c("HW_prev", "TW_prev"))
      s <- sum(ext$explanatory_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (s > 0) sum(ext$explanatory_weight[ext$source == "TW_prev"], na.rm = TRUE) / s else NA_real_
    }
  )
}


make_window_summary <- function(window_days = 1L) {
  if (window_days <= 1L) "prev_day" else paste0("recent_", window_days, "d")
}

make_external_summary_int <- function(external_window_days = 1L,
                                      external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay")) {
  external_profile_mode <- match.arg(external_profile_mode)
  base <- make_window_summary(external_window_days)
  if (external_profile_mode == "decay") paste0(base, "_decay") else base
}

make_weighted_clr_profile <- function(clr_mat, sample_names, raw_weights) {
  sample_names <- intersect(sample_names, colnames(clr_mat))
  if (length(sample_names) == 0) return(NULL)

  vals <- clr_mat[, sample_names, drop = FALSE]
  w <- raw_weights[seq_along(sample_names)]
  w[is.na(w)] <- 0
  if (sum(w) <= 0) w <- rep(1, length(sample_names))
  w <- w / sum(w)

  prof <- as.vector(vals %*% w)
  prof[is.na(prof)] <- 0
  prof
}

prepare_filtered_clr_inputs <- function(ra_tbl,
                                        id_cols,
                                        clr_tbl = NULL,
                                        min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                        min_mean_abundance = 1e-4,
                                        pseudocount = 0.5,
                                        use_existing_clr = TRUE) {
  ra_info <- ra_tbl_to_mat_int(ra_tbl, id_cols = id_cols)

  sample_cols <- colnames(ra_info$ra_mat)
  feature_meta <- ra_info$feature_meta

  keep_features <- filter_features_for_clr_source(
    ra_info$ra_mat,
    min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
    min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance
  )

  ra_mat_filt <- ra_info$ra_mat[keep_features, , drop = FALSE]
  feature_meta_filt <- feature_meta[keep_features, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!is.null(clr_tbl) && isTRUE(use_existing_clr)) {
    clr_info <- clr_tbl_to_mat_int(clr_tbl, id_cols = id_cols)

    common_samples <- intersect(colnames(ra_mat_filt), colnames(clr_info$clr_mat))
    if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
      stop("No overlapping sample columns between filtered RA table and provided CLR table.")
    }

    ra_mat_filt <- ra_mat_filt[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
    clr_mat_raw <- clr_info$clr_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]

    ra_key <- make_feature_key_int(feature_meta_filt)
    clr_key <- make_feature_key_int(clr_info$feature_meta)
    common_key <- intersect(ra_key, clr_key)
    if (length(common_key) == 0) {
      stop("No overlapping features between filtered RA table and provided CLR table.")
    }

    ra_idx <- match(common_key, ra_key)
    clr_idx <- match(common_key, clr_key)

    ra_mat_filt <- ra_mat_filt[ra_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    clr_mat_filt <- clr_mat_raw[clr_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    feature_meta_filt <- clr_info$feature_meta[clr_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    storage.mode(clr_mat_filt) <- "double"
  } else {
    ra_pc <- ra_mat_filt + pseudocount
    gm <- exp(colMeans(log(t(ra_pc))))
    clr_mat_filt <- log(ra_pc / gm)
    storage.mode(clr_mat_filt) <- "double"
  }

  list(
    ra_mat = ra_mat_filt,
    clr_mat = clr_mat_filt,
    feature_meta = feature_meta_filt,
    sample_cols = colnames(ra_mat_filt),
    keep_features = keep_features
  )
}

add_day_from_start_int <- function(meta_ptw) {
  if (nrow(meta_ptw) == 0) return(meta_ptw)

  meta_ptw %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ptrap) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(day_from_start = as.integer(date - min(date, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

compute_ptw_grouped_support_tbl_clr <- function(meta_ptw,
                                                clr_mat,
                                                meta_hw_tw,
                                                blank_profile = NULL,
                                                include_prev_ptw = TRUE,
                                                summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
                                                external_window_days = 1L,
                                                external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay"),
                                                external_decay_rate = 0.8,
                                                lambda_ridge = 0) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  external_profile_mode <- match.arg(external_profile_mode)

  if (nrow(meta_ptw) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      Sample.Name = character(),
      external_support = numeric(),
      lag_support = numeric(),
      blank_support = numeric(),
      hw_within_external = numeric(),
      tw_within_external = numeric()
    ))
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(meta_ptw$Sample.Name, function(smp) {
    y <- clr_mat[, smp]

    cand <- build_candidate_sources_for_one_ptw_clr(
      target_sample = smp,
      clr_mat = clr_mat,
      meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
      meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
      blank_profile = blank_profile,
      include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
      summary_fun = summary_fun,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
    )

    if (is.null(cand$profiles) || length(cand$profiles) == 0) {
      tibble::tibble(
        Sample.Name = smp,
        external_support = 0,
        lag_support = 0,
        blank_support = 0,
        hw_within_external = NA_real_,
        tw_within_external = NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      expl_tbl <- compute_shapley_explanatory_weights_clr(
        y = y,
        profiles = cand$profiles,
        lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge,
        source_order = c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "Prev_PTW", "BLANK"),
        value_col = "fit_r2",
        truncate_negative = TRUE
      )

      group_tbl <- collapse_explanatory_groups_int(expl_tbl)

      tibble::tibble(
        Sample.Name = smp,
        external_support = dplyr::coalesce(group_tbl$external_support[[1]], 0),
        lag_support = dplyr::coalesce(group_tbl$lag_support[[1]], 0),
        blank_support = dplyr::coalesce(group_tbl$blank_support[[1]], 0),
        hw_within_external = group_tbl$hw_within_external[[1]],
        tw_within_external = group_tbl$tw_within_external[[1]]
      )
    }
  })
}

compute_regime_signal_from_support_int <- function(external_support,
                                                   lag_support,
                                                   metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag"),
                                                   pseudocount = 1e-4) {
  metric <- match.arg(metric)
  external_support <- dplyr::coalesce(as.numeric(external_support), 0)
  lag_support <- dplyr::coalesce(as.numeric(lag_support), 0)

  if (metric == "external_fraction_nonblank") {
    return(external_support / (external_support + lag_support + pseudocount))
  }
  if (metric == "external_minus_lag") {
    return(external_support - lag_support)
  }
  log((external_support + pseudocount) / (lag_support + pseudocount))
}

describe_regime_metric_int <- function(metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag")) {
  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  if (metric == "external_fraction_nonblank") {
    return(list(
      title = "Support-driven regime signal (external / [external + lag])",
      y = "external support fraction among non-blank support"
    ))
  }
  if (metric == "external_minus_lag") {
    return(list(
      title = "Support-driven regime signal (external - lag)",
      y = "external support minus lag support"
    ))
  }
  list(
    title = "Support-driven regime signal (log[(external + pc)/(lag + pc)])",
    y = "log external-to-lag support"
  )
}

assign_support_driven_regime_int <- function(meta_ptw,
                                             support_tbl,
                                             metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag"),
                                             pseudocount = 1e-4,
                                             early_day_max = 14L,
                                             mid_day_max = 35L) {
  metric <- match.arg(metric)
  if (nrow(meta_ptw) == 0) return(meta_ptw)

  out <- meta_ptw %>%
    add_day_from_start_int() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(support_tbl, by = "Sample.Name") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      external_support = dplyr::coalesce(external_support, 0),
      lag_support = dplyr::coalesce(lag_support, 0),
      blank_support = dplyr::coalesce(blank_support, 0),
      regime_signal = compute_regime_signal_from_support_int(
        external_support = external_support,
        lag_support = lag_support,
        metric = metric,
        pseudocount = pseudocount
      ),
      regime_break_day = as.numeric(early_day_max),
      regime_break_day_2 = as.numeric(mid_day_max)
    ) %>%
    add_phase_columns_int(early_day_max = early_day_max, mid_day_max = mid_day_max)

  attr(out, "regime_metric") <- metric
  attr(out, "regime_assignment") <- "fixed_day"
  attr(out, "early_day_max") <- early_day_max
  attr(out, "mid_day_max") <- mid_day_max
  out
}

summarise_regime_assignments_int <- function(meta_ptw) {
  early_day_max <- attr(meta_ptw, "early_day_max") %||% 14L
  mid_day_max <- attr(meta_ptw, "mid_day_max") %||% 35L

  meta_ptw %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ptrap) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      early_end_day = early_day_max,
      mid_end_day = mid_day_max,
      n_early = sum(phase == "early", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_mid = sum(phase == "mid", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_late = sum(phase == "late", na.rm = TRUE),
      max_regime_signal = max(regime_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_external_support = mean(external_support, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_lag_support = mean(lag_support, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_blank_support = mean(blank_support, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_regime_signal_int <- function(meta_ptw, title = NULL) {
  metric_desc <- describe_regime_metric_int(attr(meta_ptw, "regime_metric") %||% "external_fraction_nonblank")
  early_day_max <- attr(meta_ptw, "early_day_max") %||% 14L
  mid_day_max <- attr(meta_ptw, "mid_day_max") %||% 35L

  ggplot2::ggplot(meta_ptw, ggplot2::aes(x = day_from_start, y = regime_signal, color = phase)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(group = 1), color = "grey60") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(early_day_max, mid_day_max), linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ ptrap, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title %||% "Fixed-day regime support signal",
      subtitle = paste0("Fixed-day phase definition (<=", early_day_max, ", <=", mid_day_max, "); signal = ", metric_desc),
      x = "days from start",
      y = "support-derived regime signal",
      color = "phase"
    )
}

run_early_late_taxon_attribution_clr <- function(clr_tbl,
                                                 ra_tbl,
                                                 metadata,
                                                 pcr_keep,
                                                 ptw_ptraps = c(1, 2, 3),
                                                 include_prev_ptw = TRUE,
                                                 summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
                                                 min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                                 min_mean_abundance = 1e-4,
                                                 blank_patterns = c("^blank", "water_blank"),
                                                 keep_phases = c("early", "late"),
                                                 external_window_days = 1L,
                                                 external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay"),
                                                 external_decay_rate = 0.8,
                                                 lambda_ridge = 0,
                                                 regime_metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag"),
                                                 regime_pseudocount = 1e-4) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  regime_metric <- match.arg(regime_metric)

  prep <- prepare_filtered_clr_inputs(
    ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
    clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
    id_cols = id_cols,
    min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
    min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
    pseudocount = 0.5
  )

  ra_mat <- prep$ra_mat
  clr_mat <- prep$clr_mat
  feature_meta <- prep$feature_meta %>%
    dplyr::mutate(feature_index = dplyr::row_number())

  meta_sub <- metadata %>%
    filter(PCR.cycles == pcr_keep) %>%
    mutate(
      date = if ("date" %in% names(.)) as.Date(date) else extract_date_from_name_int(Sample.Name),
      ptrap = if ("ptrap" %in% names(.)) ptrap else extract_ptrap_from_name_int(Sample.Name)
    )

  meta_ptw <- meta_sub %>%
    filter(Phenotype == "PTW", ptrap %in% ptw_ptraps) %>%
    filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    add_day_from_start_int()

  meta_hw_tw <- meta_sub %>%
    filter(Phenotype %in% c("HW", "TW")) %>%
    filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    arrange(date)

  blank_from_name <- meta_sub %>%
    filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    filter(grepl(paste(blank_patterns, collapse = "|"), Sample.Name, ignore.case = TRUE))

  blank_from_type <- if ("Phenotype" %in% names(meta_sub)) {
    meta_sub %>%
      filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
      filter(grepl("blank", Phenotype, ignore.case = TRUE))
  } else {
    tibble()
  }

  blank_samples <- bind_rows(blank_from_name, blank_from_type) %>%
    distinct(Sample.Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  blank_profile <- NULL
  if (nrow(blank_samples) > 0) {
    blank_profile <- make_clr_profile(clr_mat, blank_samples$Sample.Name, summary_fun = summary_fun)
  }

  support_tbl <- compute_ptw_grouped_support_tbl_clr(
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    clr_mat = clr_mat,
    meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
    blank_profile = blank_profile,
    include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
    summary_fun = summary_fun,
    external_window_days = external_window_days,
    external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
    external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate,
    lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
  )

  meta_ptw <- assign_support_driven_regime_int(
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    support_tbl = support_tbl,
    metric = regime_metric,
    pseudocount = regime_pseudocount
  )

  feature_level_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(meta_ptw$Sample.Name, function(smp) {
    row_now <- meta_ptw %>% filter(Sample.Name == smp)
    y <- clr_mat[, smp]

    cand <- build_candidate_sources_for_one_ptw_clr(
      target_sample = smp,
      clr_mat = clr_mat,
      meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
      meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
      blank_profile = blank_profile,
      include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
      summary_fun = summary_fun,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
    )

    profiles <- cand$profiles

    fit_blank <- fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      model_name = "M_blank",
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )

    fit_ext <- fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      model_name = "M_ext",
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )

    fit_lag <- fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      model_name = "M_lag",
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )

    fit_full <- fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr(
      y = y,
      profiles = profiles,
      model_name = "M_full",
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
    )

    err_blank <- if (!all(is.na(fit_blank$err_vec[[1]]))) fit_blank$err_vec[[1]] else rep(NA_real_, length(y))
    err_ext   <- if (!all(is.na(fit_ext$err_vec[[1]])))   fit_ext$err_vec[[1]]   else rep(NA_real_, length(y))
    err_lag   <- if (!all(is.na(fit_lag$err_vec[[1]])))   fit_lag$err_vec[[1]]   else rep(NA_real_, length(y))
    err_full  <- if (!all(is.na(fit_full$err_vec[[1]])))  fit_full$err_vec[[1]]  else rep(NA_real_, length(y))

    tibble(
      Sample.Name = smp,
      ptrap = row_now$ptrap[[1]],
      date = row_now$date[[1]],
      day_from_start = row_now$day_from_start[[1]],
      phase = row_now$phase[[1]],
      feature_index = feature_meta$feature_index,
      observed_clr = y,
      observed_ra = ra_mat[, smp],
      yhat_blank = if (!is.null(fit_blank)) fit_blank$yhat[[1]] else NA_real_,
      yhat_ext = if (!is.null(fit_ext)) fit_ext$yhat[[1]] else NA_real_,
      yhat_lag = if (!is.null(fit_lag)) fit_lag$yhat[[1]] else NA_real_,
      yhat_full = if (!is.null(fit_full)) fit_full$yhat[[1]] else NA_real_,
      improve_ext_over_blank = err_blank - err_ext,
      improve_lag_over_blank = err_blank - err_lag,
      improve_full_over_lag = err_lag - err_full,
      improve_full_over_ext = err_ext - err_full
    ) %>%
      left_join(feature_meta, by = "feature_index")
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")),
      taxon_label = if ("Taxon" %in% names(.)) as.character(Taxon) else as.character(id)
    )

  taxon_phase_summary <- feature_level_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(phase) %in% keep_phases) %>%
    group_by(phase, taxon_label) %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples = n_distinct(Sample.Name),
      prevalence_in_phase = mean(observed_ra > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_observed_clr = mean(observed_clr, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_observed_clr = median(observed_clr, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_observed_ra = mean(observed_ra, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_observed_ra = median(observed_ra, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum_imp_ext_over_blank = sum(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_ext_over_blank = mean(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_ext_over_blank = median(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_ext_over_blank = mean(improve_ext_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum_imp_lag_over_blank = sum(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_lag_over_blank = mean(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_lag_over_blank = median(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_lag_over_blank = mean(improve_lag_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum_imp_full_over_lag = sum(improve_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_full_over_lag = mean(improve_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_full_over_lag = median(improve_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_full_over_lag = mean(improve_full_over_lag > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum_imp_full_over_ext = sum(improve_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_full_over_ext = mean(improve_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_full_over_ext = median(improve_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_full_over_ext = mean(improve_full_over_ext > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  early_external_taxa <- taxon_phase_summary %>%
    filter(phase == "early", prevalence_in_phase >= 0.10, n_samples >= 3) %>%
    arrange(desc(sum_imp_full_over_lag), desc(mean_imp_full_over_lag))

  late_persistent_taxa <- taxon_phase_summary %>%
    filter(phase == "late", prevalence_in_phase >= 0.10, n_samples >= 5) %>%
    arrange(desc(sum_imp_lag_over_blank), desc(mean_imp_lag_over_blank))

  lag_phase_contrast <- taxon_phase_summary %>%
    filter(phase %in% c("early", "late")) %>%
    select(
      phase, taxon_label,
      prevalence_in_phase,
      mean_observed_ra,
      sum_imp_lag_over_blank,
      mean_imp_lag_over_blank,
      prop_pos_lag_over_blank
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(prevalence_in_phase, mean_observed_ra,
                      sum_imp_lag_over_blank, mean_imp_lag_over_blank,
                      prop_pos_lag_over_blank),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_mean_imp_lag_late_minus_early = mean_imp_lag_over_blank_late - mean_imp_lag_over_blank_early,
      delta_sum_imp_lag_late_minus_early = sum_imp_lag_over_blank_late - sum_imp_lag_over_blank_early
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(delta_mean_imp_lag_late_minus_early))

  plot_top_taxa_int <- function(tbl, value_col, title, top_n = 15) {
    value_col <- rlang::ensym(value_col)
    plot_tbl <- tbl %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      mutate(taxon_label = forcats::fct_reorder(taxon_label, !!value_col))

    ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = taxon_label, y = !!value_col)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = rlang::as_name(value_col))
  }

  p_top_early_external <- plot_top_taxa_int(
    early_external_taxa,
    sum_imp_full_over_lag,
    title = paste0("Top pre-shift external-attributed taxa (full over lag; CLR; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), ")"),
    top_n = 15
  )

  p_top_late_persistent <- plot_top_taxa_int(
    late_persistent_taxa,
    sum_imp_lag_over_blank,
    title = paste0("Top post-shift persistent taxa (lag over blank; CLR; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), ")"),
    top_n = 15
  )

  list(
    feature_level_tbl = feature_level_tbl,
    taxon_phase_summary = taxon_phase_summary,
    early_external_taxa = early_external_taxa,
    late_persistent_taxa = late_persistent_taxa,
    lag_phase_contrast = lag_phase_contrast,
    p_top_early_external = p_top_early_external,
    p_top_late_persistent = p_top_late_persistent,
    regime_summary = summarise_regime_assignments_int(meta_ptw),
    p_regime_signal = plot_regime_signal_int(meta_ptw, title = paste0("Fixed-day regime support signal (PCR ", pcr_keep, ")")),
    external_window_days = external_window_days,
    external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
    external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
  )
}

build_candidate_sources_for_one_ptw_clr <- function(target_sample,
                                                    clr_mat,
                                                    meta_ptw,
                                                    meta_hw_tw,
                                                    blank_profile = NULL,
                                                    include_prev_ptw = TRUE,
                                                    summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
                                                    external_window_days = 1L,
                                                    external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay"),
                                                    external_decay_rate = 0.8,
                                                    require_same_sampling_time = FALSE,
                                                    treated_ptraps = c(1L, 3L),
                                                    control_ptrap = 2L) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  external_profile_mode <- match.arg(external_profile_mode)
  external_window_days <- as.integer(external_window_days)

  row_now <- meta_ptw %>% dplyr::filter(Sample.Name == target_sample)
  if (nrow(row_now) != 1) {
    stop("target_sample not uniquely found in meta_ptw: ", target_sample)
  }

  current_date <- row_now$date[[1]]
  current_ptrap <- row_now$ptrap[[1]]
  current_sampling_time <- row_now$sampling_time[[1]]

  ext_candidates <- meta_hw_tw %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      date < current_date,
      date >= current_date - external_window_days
    )

  if (isTRUE(require_same_sampling_time) && "sampling_time" %in% names(ext_candidates)) {
    ext_candidates <- ext_candidates %>%
      dplyr::filter(sampling_time == current_sampling_time)
  }

  ext_candidates <- ext_candidates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_chr = as.character(label),
      ptrap_chr = as.character(ptrap),
      shared_treated_input = ptrap_chr == "a" | label_chr %in% c("Pa", "Aa"),
      ptrap_match = dplyr::case_when(
        current_ptrap %in% treated_ptraps & shared_treated_input ~ TRUE,
        !is.na(ptrap_chr) ~ ptrap_chr == as.character(current_ptrap),
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ptrap_match)

  build_ext_profile_int <- function(phenotype_now) {
    sub <- ext_candidates %>%
      dplyr::filter(Phenotype == phenotype_now) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date))

    smps <- sub$Sample.Name
    if (length(smps) == 0) {
      return(list(profile = NULL, samples = character(0), weight_string = ""))
    }

    if (external_profile_mode == "decay") {
      day_lag <- as.numeric(current_date - sub$date)
      day_lag[is.na(day_lag)] <- external_window_days
      raw_w <- exp(-external_decay_rate * pmax(day_lag, 1))
      prof <- make_weighted_clr_profile(clr_mat, smps, raw_w)
      weight_string <- paste0(smps, ":", round(raw_w / sum(raw_w), 3), collapse = ";")
    } else {
      prof <- make_clr_profile(clr_mat, smps, summary_fun = summary_fun)
      weight_string <- "uniform_summary"
    }

    list(profile = prof, samples = smps, weight_string = weight_string)
  }

  hw_info <- list(profile = NULL, samples = character(0), weight_string = "")
  tw_info <- list(profile = NULL, samples = character(0), weight_string = "")

  hw_info <- build_ext_profile_int("HW")
  tw_info <- build_ext_profile_int("TW")

  prev_ptw_sample <- NA_character_
  prev_prof <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(include_prev_ptw)) {
    prev_ptw_sample <- meta_ptw %>%
      dplyr::filter(ptrap == current_ptrap, date < current_date) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Sample.Name)

    if (length(prev_ptw_sample) == 1 && !is.na(prev_ptw_sample)) {
      prev_prof <- make_clr_profile(clr_mat, prev_ptw_sample, summary_fun = summary_fun)
    } else {
      prev_ptw_sample <- NA_character_
      prev_prof <- NULL
    }
  }

  profiles <- list()
  if (!is.null(hw_info$profile)) profiles$HW_prev <- hw_info$profile
  if (!is.null(tw_info$profile)) profiles$TW_prev <- tw_info$profile
  if (!is.null(prev_prof)) profiles$Prev_PTW <- prev_prof
  if (!is.null(blank_profile)) profiles$BLANK <- blank_profile

  X <- NULL
  if (length(profiles) > 0) X <- do.call(cbind, profiles)

  list(
    profiles = profiles,
    X = X,
    details = list(
      HW_prev_samples = paste(hw_info$samples, collapse = ";"),
      TW_prev_samples = paste(tw_info$samples, collapse = ";"),
      HW_prev_weight_string = hw_info$weight_string,
      TW_prev_weight_string = tw_info$weight_string,
      Prev_PTW_sample = if (length(prev_ptw_sample) == 0) "" else prev_ptw_sample,
      external_window = make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode),
      allowed_external = "matched_prev_day_HW_or_TW"
    )
  )
}

add_phase_columns_int <- function(df,
                                  early_day_max = 14L,
                                  mid_day_max = 35L) {
  if (!"day_from_start" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(ptrap) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(day_from_start = as.integer(date - min(date, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      phase = dplyr::case_when(
        day_from_start <= early_day_max ~ "early",
        day_from_start <= mid_day_max ~ "mid",
        TRUE ~ "late"
      ),
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late"))
    )
}

summarise_grouped_support_tbl <- function(fit_tbl, group_vars = NULL) {
  df <- add_phase_columns_int(fit_tbl)
  if (is.null(group_vars) || length(group_vars) == 0) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_samples = dplyr::n(),
        median_external_support = median(external_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_lag_support = median(lag_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_blank_support = median(blank_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_external_support = mean(external_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_lag_support = mean(lag_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_blank_support = mean(blank_support, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  } else {
    df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_samples = dplyr::n(),
        median_external_support = median(external_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_lag_support = median(lag_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_blank_support = median(blank_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_external_support = mean(external_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_lag_support = mean(lag_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_blank_support = mean(blank_support, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
}

bootstrap_nested_delta_ci <- function(comparison_tbl,
                                      group_vars = NULL,
                                      n_boot = 500L,
                                      seed = 1L) {
  metrics <- c(
    "delta_lag_over_blank",
    "delta_ext_over_blank",
    "delta_full_over_lag",
    "delta_full_over_ext"
  )

  summarise_once_int <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(group_vars) || length(group_vars) == 0) {
      df %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(metrics), ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
    } else {
      df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(metrics), ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
    }
  }

  resample_once_int <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(group_vars) || length(group_vars) == 0) {
      df[sample.int(nrow(df), size = nrow(df), replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
        dplyr::group_modify(~ .x[sample.int(nrow(.x), size = nrow(.x), replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()
    }
  }

  point_est <- summarise_once_int(comparison_tbl) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(metrics), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "estimate")

  set.seed(seed)
  boot_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_boot), function(b) {
    resample_once_int(comparison_tbl) %>%
      summarise_once_int() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.boot = b)
  }) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(metrics), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "value")

  ci_tbl <- if (is.null(group_vars) || length(group_vars) == 0) {
    boot_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(statistic) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        ci_low = stats::quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        ci_high = stats::quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    boot_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars)), statistic) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        ci_low = stats::quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        ci_high = stats::quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }

  dplyr::left_join(point_est, ci_tbl, by = c(group_vars, "statistic"))
}

run_ptw_clr_source_model <- function(clr_tbl,
                                     ra_tbl,
                                     metadata,
                                     pcr_keep,
                                     ptw_ptraps = c(1, 2, 3),
                                     include_prev_ptw = TRUE,
                                     summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
                                     min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                     min_mean_abundance = 1e-4,
                                     blank_patterns = c("^blank", "water_blank"),
                                     external_window_days = 1L,
                                     external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay"),
                                     external_decay_rate = 0.8,
                                     lambda_ridge = 0,
                                     title_suffix = NULL,
                                     regime_metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag"),
                                     regime_pseudocount = 1e-4,
                                     prep = NULL) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  regime_metric <- match.arg(regime_metric)
  external_profile_mode <- match.arg(external_profile_mode)
  title_suffix <- title_suffix %||% paste0("PCR ", pcr_keep)

  if (is.null(prep)) {
    prep <- prepare_filtered_clr_inputs(
      ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
      clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
      id_cols = id_cols,
      min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
      min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
      pseudocount = 0.5
    )
  }


  ra_mat <- prep$ra_mat
  clr_mat <- prep$clr_mat
  feature_meta <- prep$feature_meta

  meta_sub <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(PCR.cycles == pcr_keep) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      date = if ("date" %in% names(.)) as.Date(date) else extract_date_from_name_int(Sample.Name),
      ptrap = if ("ptrap" %in% names(.)) ptrap else extract_ptrap_from_name_int(Sample.Name)
    )
  if (!("sampling_time" %in% names(meta_sub))) meta_sub$sampling_time <- NA_character_

  meta_ptw <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Phenotype == "PTW", ptrap %in% ptw_ptraps) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    add_day_from_start_int()

  meta_hw_tw <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Phenotype %in% c("HW", "TW")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date)

  blank_from_name <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(paste(blank_patterns, collapse = "|"), Sample.Name, ignore.case = TRUE))

  blank_from_type <- if ("Phenotype" %in% names(meta_sub)) {
    meta_sub %>%
      dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(grepl("blank", Phenotype, ignore.case = TRUE))
  } else {
    tibble::tibble()
  }

  blank_samples <- dplyr::bind_rows(blank_from_name, blank_from_type) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Sample.Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  blank_profile <- NULL
  if (nrow(blank_samples) > 0) {
    blank_profile <- make_clr_profile(clr_mat, blank_samples$Sample.Name, summary_fun = summary_fun)
  }

  all_source_names <- c("HW_prev", "TW_prev", "Prev_PTW", "BLANK")

  fit_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(meta_ptw$Sample.Name, function(smp) {
    row_now <- meta_ptw %>% dplyr::filter(Sample.Name == smp)
    y <- clr_mat[, smp]

    cand <- build_candidate_sources_for_one_ptw_clr(
      target_sample = smp,
      clr_mat = clr_mat,
      meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
      meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
      blank_profile = blank_profile,
      include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
      summary_fun = summary_fun,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
    )

    if (is.null(cand$profiles) || length(cand$profiles) == 0) {
      fit_res <- tibble::tibble(
        fit_sse = NA_real_, fit_rmse = NA_real_, fit_r2 = NA_real_, fit_cosine = NA_real_, converged = FALSE
      )
      for (nm in all_source_names) {
        fit_res[[nm]] <- 0
        fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_simplex")]] <- 0
        fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_shapley")]] <- 0
      }
      fit_res$blank_support <- 0
      fit_res$lag_support <- 0
      fit_res$external_support <- 0
      fit_res$hw_within_external <- NA_real_
      fit_res$tw_within_external <- NA_real_
      fit_res$n_sources <- 0
    } else {
      fit_full <- fit_subset_model_clr(
        y = y,
        profiles = cand$profiles,
        use_sources = names(cand$profiles),
        lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
      )

      expl_tbl <- compute_shapley_explanatory_weights_clr(
        y = y,
        profiles = cand$profiles,
        lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge,
        source_order = all_source_names,
        value_col = "fit_r2",
        truncate_negative = TRUE
      )

      group_tbl <- collapse_explanatory_groups_int(expl_tbl)
      w_raw <- fit_full$simplex_weight[[1]]

      fit_res <- tibble::tibble(
        fit_sse = fit_full$fit_sse,
        fit_rmse = fit_full$fit_rmse,
        fit_r2 = fit_full$fit_r2,
        fit_cosine = fit_full$fit_cosine,
        converged = fit_full$converged
      )
      for (nm in all_source_names) {
        fit_res[[nm]] <- 0
        fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_simplex")]] <- 0
        fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_shapley")]] <- 0
      }
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(expl_tbl))) {
        nm <- expl_tbl$source[[i]]
        fit_res[[nm]] <- expl_tbl$explanatory_weight[[i]]
        fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_shapley")]] <- expl_tbl$shapley_value[[i]]
      }
      if (length(w_raw) > 0) {
        for (nm in names(w_raw)) fit_res[[paste0(nm, "_simplex")]] <- unname(w_raw[[nm]])
      }
      fit_res$blank_support <- group_tbl$blank_support
      fit_res$lag_support <- group_tbl$lag_support
      fit_res$external_support <- group_tbl$external_support
      fit_res$hw_within_external <- group_tbl$hw_within_external
      fit_res$tw_within_external <- group_tbl$tw_within_external
      fit_res$n_sources <- length(cand$profiles)
    }

    fit_res %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Sample.Name = smp,
        day_from_start = row_now$day_from_start[[1]],
        PCR.cycles = row_now$PCR.cycles[[1]],
        Phenotype = row_now$Phenotype[[1]],
        ptrap = row_now$ptrap[[1]],
        date = row_now$date[[1]],
        candidate_HW_prev = cand$details$HW_prev_samples != "",
        candidate_TW_prev = cand$details$TW_prev_samples != "",
        candidate_Prev_PTW = !is.na(cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample) && cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample != "",
        candidate_BLANK = !is.null(blank_profile),
        HW_prev_samples = cand$details$HW_prev_samples,
        TW_prev_samples = cand$details$TW_prev_samples,
        HW_prev_weight_string = cand$details$HW_prev_weight_string,
        TW_prev_weight_string = cand$details$TW_prev_weight_string,
        Prev_PTW_sample = cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample,
        external_window = cand$details$external_window
      )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(
      Sample.Name, PCR.cycles, Phenotype, ptrap, date, external_window,
      n_sources,
      candidate_HW_prev, candidate_TW_prev, candidate_Prev_PTW, candidate_BLANK,
      HW_prev_samples, TW_prev_samples, HW_prev_weight_string, TW_prev_weight_string, Prev_PTW_sample,
      external_support, lag_support, blank_support,
      HW_prev, TW_prev, Prev_PTW, BLANK,
      HW_prev_simplex, TW_prev_simplex, Prev_PTW_simplex, BLANK_simplex,
      HW_prev_shapley, TW_prev_shapley, Prev_PTW_shapley, BLANK_shapley,
      fit_sse, fit_rmse, fit_r2, fit_cosine, converged
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ptrap, date)

  meta_ptw <- assign_support_driven_regime_int(
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    support_tbl = fit_tbl %>% dplyr::select(Sample.Name, external_support, lag_support, blank_support),
    metric = regime_metric,
    pseudocount = regime_pseudocount
  )

  fit_tbl <- fit_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      meta_ptw %>%
        dplyr::select(Sample.Name, phase, regime_break_day, regime_break_day_2, regime_signal),
      by = "Sample.Name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ptrap, date)

  weights_long <- fit_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample.Name, ptrap, date, HW_prev, TW_prev, Prev_PTW, BLANK, fit_r2) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(HW_prev, TW_prev, Prev_PTW, BLANK), names_to = "source", values_to = "weight")

  support_long <- fit_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample.Name, ptrap, date, external_support, lag_support, blank_support) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(external_support, lag_support, blank_support), names_to = "support_type", values_to = "support")

  p_weights <- ggplot2::ggplot(weights_long, ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = weight, fill = source)) +
    ggplot2::geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ ptrap, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Dynamic source explanation by time (", title_suffix, "; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), "; CLR/Shapley)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "explanatory weight"
    )

  p_support <- ggplot2::ggplot(support_long, ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = support, fill = support_type)) +
    ggplot2::geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ ptrap, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Dynamic grouped explanatory support (", title_suffix, "; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), ")"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "grouped explanatory support"
    )

  p_fit <- fit_tbl %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = fit_r2, color = factor(ptrap), group = ptrap)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Dynamic mixture fit quality across time (", title_suffix, "; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), "; CLR)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "fit R2 (CLR)",
      color = "ptrap"
    )

  list(
    fit_tbl = fit_tbl,
    weights_long = weights_long,
    support_long = support_long,
    p_weights = p_weights,
    p_support = p_support,
    p_fit = p_fit,
    p_regime_signal = plot_regime_signal_int(meta_ptw, title = paste0("Fixed-day regime support signal (", title_suffix, ")")),
    regime_summary = summarise_regime_assignments_int(meta_ptw),
    ra_mat = ra_mat,
    clr_mat = clr_mat,
    feature_meta = feature_meta,
    blank_samples = blank_samples,
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
    external_window_days = external_window_days,
    external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
    external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
  )
}

run_ptw_clr_nested_model_comparison <- function(clr_tbl,
                                                ra_tbl,
                                                metadata,
                                                pcr_keep,
                                                ptw_ptraps = c(1, 2, 3),
                                                include_prev_ptw = TRUE,
                                                summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
                                                min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                                min_mean_abundance = 1e-4,
                                                blank_patterns = c("^blank", "water_blank"),
                                                external_window_days = 1L,
                                                external_profile_mode = c("summary", "decay"),
                                                external_decay_rate = 0.8,
                                                lambda_ridge = 0,
                                                title_suffix = NULL,
                                                regime_metric = c("external_fraction_nonblank", "external_minus_lag", "log_external_over_lag"),
                                                regime_pseudocount = 1e-4,
                                                prep = NULL) {
  summary_fun <- match.arg(summary_fun)
  regime_metric <- match.arg(regime_metric)
  external_profile_mode <- match.arg(external_profile_mode)
  title_suffix <- title_suffix %||% paste0("PCR ", pcr_keep)

  if (is.null(prep)) {
    prep <- prepare_filtered_clr_inputs(
      ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
      clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
      id_cols = id_cols,
      min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
      min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
      pseudocount = 0.5
    )
  }

  ra_mat <- prep$ra_mat
  clr_mat <- prep$clr_mat
  feature_meta <- prep$feature_meta

  meta_sub <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(PCR.cycles == pcr_keep) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      date = if ("date" %in% names(.)) as.Date(date) else extract_date_from_name_int(Sample.Name),
      ptrap = if ("ptrap" %in% names(.)) ptrap else extract_ptrap_from_name_int(Sample.Name)
    )
  if (!("sampling_time" %in% names(meta_sub))) meta_sub$sampling_time <- NA_character_

  meta_ptw <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Phenotype == "PTW", ptrap %in% ptw_ptraps) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    add_day_from_start_int() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ptrap, date)

  meta_hw_tw <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Phenotype %in% c("HW", "TW")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date)

  blank_from_name <- meta_sub %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(paste(blank_patterns, collapse = "|"), Sample.Name, ignore.case = TRUE))

  blank_from_type <- if ("Phenotype" %in% names(meta_sub)) {
    meta_sub %>% dplyr::filter(Sample.Name %in% colnames(clr_mat)) %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("blank", Phenotype, ignore.case = TRUE))
  } else {
    tibble::tibble()
  }

  blank_samples <- dplyr::bind_rows(blank_from_name, blank_from_type) %>% dplyr::distinct(Sample.Name, .keep_all = TRUE)
  blank_profile <- NULL
  if (nrow(blank_samples) > 0) blank_profile <- make_clr_profile(clr_mat, blank_samples$Sample.Name, summary_fun = summary_fun)

  support_tbl <- compute_ptw_grouped_support_tbl_clr(
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    clr_mat = clr_mat,
    meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
    blank_profile = blank_profile,
    include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
    summary_fun = summary_fun,
    external_window_days = external_window_days,
    external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
    external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate,
    lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
  )

  meta_ptw <- assign_support_driven_regime_int(
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    support_tbl = support_tbl,
    metric = regime_metric,
    pseudocount = regime_pseudocount
  )

  model_results_long <- purrr::map_dfr(meta_ptw$Sample.Name, function(smp) {
    row_now <- meta_ptw %>% dplyr::filter(Sample.Name == smp)
    y <- clr_mat[, smp]

    cand <- build_candidate_sources_for_one_ptw_clr(
      target_sample = smp,
      clr_mat = clr_mat,
      meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
      meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
      blank_profile = blank_profile,
      include_prev_ptw = include_prev_ptw,
      summary_fun = summary_fun,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
    )

    profiles <- cand$profiles
    model_names <- c("M_blank", "M_ext", "M_lag", "M_full")

    purrr::map_dfr(model_names, function(mn) {
      fit <- fit_named_model_from_profiles_clr(
        y = y,
        profiles = profiles,
        model_name = mn,
        lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge
      )

      fit %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Sample.Name = smp,
          ptrap = row_now$ptrap[[1]],
          date = row_now$date[[1]],
          has_HW_prev = cand$details$HW_prev_samples != "",
          has_TW_prev = cand$details$TW_prev_samples != "",
          has_Prev_PTW = !is.na(cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample) && cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample != "",
          has_BLANK = !is.null(blank_profile),
          HW_prev_samples = cand$details$HW_prev_samples,
          TW_prev_samples = cand$details$TW_prev_samples,
          HW_prev_weight_string = cand$details$HW_prev_weight_string,
          TW_prev_weight_string = cand$details$TW_prev_weight_string,
          Prev_PTW_sample = cand$details$Prev_PTW_sample,
          external_window = cand$details$external_window
        )
    })
  }) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Sample.Name, ptrap, date, external_window, model,
      has_HW_prev, has_TW_prev, has_Prev_PTW, has_BLANK,
      HW_prev, TW_prev, Prev_PTW, BLANK,
      HW_prev_samples, TW_prev_samples, HW_prev_weight_string, TW_prev_weight_string, Prev_PTW_sample,
      fit_sse, fit_rmse, fit_r2, fit_cosine, converged, n_sources_model
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ptrap, date, model)

  comparison_tbl <- model_results_long %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample.Name, ptrap, date, external_window, model, fit_r2, fit_rmse, fit_cosine, n_sources_model,
           has_HW_prev, has_TW_prev, has_Prev_PTW, has_BLANK,
           HW_prev_samples, TW_prev_samples, Prev_PTW_sample) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(fit_r2, fit_rmse, fit_cosine, n_sources_model), names_glue = "{.value}_{model}") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      meta_ptw %>%
        dplyr::select(Sample.Name, day_from_start, phase, regime_break_day,
                      regime_break_day_2, regime_signal),
      by = "Sample.Name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      delta_lag_over_blank = fit_r2_M_lag - fit_r2_M_blank,
      delta_ext_over_blank = fit_r2_M_ext - fit_r2_M_blank,
      delta_full_over_lag = fit_r2_M_full - fit_r2_M_lag,
      delta_full_over_ext = fit_r2_M_full - fit_r2_M_ext
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ptrap, date)
  
  comparison_tbl <- comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      treatment_group = dplyr::case_when(
        ptrap %in% c(1, 3) ~ "treated",
        ptrap == 2 ~ "control",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    )

  overall_summary <- comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      n_ext_available = sum(has_HW_prev | has_TW_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lag_available = sum(has_Prev_PTW, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_full_available = sum((has_HW_prev | has_TW_prev) & has_Prev_PTW, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_blank = median(fit_r2_M_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_ext = median(fit_r2_M_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_lag = median(fit_r2_M_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_full = median(fit_r2_M_full, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_lag_over_blank = median(delta_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_ext_over_blank = median(delta_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_lag = median(delta_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_ext = median(delta_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_lag_over_blank_pos = mean(delta_lag_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_ext_over_blank_pos = mean(delta_ext_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_full_over_lag_pos = mean(delta_full_over_lag > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_full_over_ext_pos = mean(delta_full_over_ext > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  phase_summary <- comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::group_by(phase) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      median_r2_blank = median(fit_r2_M_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_ext = median(fit_r2_M_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_lag = median(fit_r2_M_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_full = median(fit_r2_M_full, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_lag_over_blank = median(delta_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_ext_over_blank = median(delta_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_lag = median(delta_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_ext = median(delta_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_lag_over_blank_pos = mean(delta_lag_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_ext_over_blank_pos = mean(delta_ext_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_full_over_lag_pos = mean(delta_full_over_lag > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_delta_full_over_ext_pos = mean(delta_full_over_ext > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ptrap_summary <- comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ptrap) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      median_r2_blank = median(fit_r2_M_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_ext = median(fit_r2_M_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_lag = median(fit_r2_M_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r2_full = median(fit_r2_M_full, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_lag_over_blank = median(delta_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_ext_over_blank = median(delta_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_lag = median(delta_full_over_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_full_over_ext = median(delta_full_over_ext, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_model_r2 <- model_results_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("M_blank", "M_ext", "M_lag", "M_full"))) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = fit_r2, color = model, group = model)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ ptrap, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Nested model comparison across time (", title_suffix, "; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), "; CLR)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "fit R2 (CLR)",
      color = "model"
    )

  delta_long <- comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample.Name, ptrap, date, phase, delta_lag_over_blank, delta_ext_over_blank, delta_full_over_lag, delta_full_over_ext) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = tidyselect::starts_with("delta_"), names_to = "comparison", values_to = "delta_r2")

  p_delta_by_phase <- ggplot2::ggplot(delta_long, ggplot2::aes(x = phase, y = delta_r2)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ comparison, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("R2 gain by fixed-day phase (", title_suffix, "; ", make_external_summary_int(external_window_days, external_profile_mode), "; CLR)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "delta R2"
    )

  list(
    model_results_long = model_results_long,
    comparison_tbl = comparison_tbl,
    overall_summary = overall_summary,
    phase_summary = phase_summary,
    ptrap_summary = ptrap_summary,
    regime_summary = summarise_regime_assignments_int(meta_ptw),
    p_model_r2 = p_model_r2,
    p_delta_by_phase = p_delta_by_phase,
    p_regime_signal = plot_regime_signal_int(meta_ptw, title = paste0("Fixed-day regime support signal (", title_suffix, ")")),
    blank_samples = blank_samples,
    meta_ptw = meta_ptw,
    meta_hw_tw = meta_hw_tw,
    external_window_days = external_window_days,
    external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
    external_decay_rate = external_decay_rate
  )
}

run_source_suite_with_sensitivity <- function(clr_tbl,
                                              ra_tbl,
                                              metadata,
                                              pcr_keep,
                                              title_base,
                                              external_specs = NULL,
                                              lambda_ridge = 0.01,
                                              n_boot_ci = 500L,
                                              seed_boot_ci = 1L,
                                              min_prevalence = 0.05,
                                              min_mean_abundance = 1e-4,
                                              ...) {

  prep_shared <- prepare_filtered_clr_inputs(
    ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
    clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
    id_cols = id_cols,
    min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
    min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
    pseudocount = 0.5
  )

  if (is.null(external_specs)) {
    external_specs <- tibble::tibble(
      spec_id = c("prev_day", "recent_3d", "recent_3d_decay"),
      external_window_days = c(1L, 3L, 3L),
      external_profile_mode = c("summary", "summary", "decay"),
      external_decay_rate = c(NA_real_, NA_real_, 0.8)
    )
  }

  dyn_list <- purrr::pmap(external_specs, function(spec_id, external_window_days, external_profile_mode, external_decay_rate) {
    run_ptw_clr_source_model(
      clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
      ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
      metadata = metadata,
      pcr_keep = pcr_keep,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = ifelse(is.na(external_decay_rate), 0.8, external_decay_rate),
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge,
      title_suffix = title_base,
      min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
      min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
      prep = prep_shared,
      ...
    )
  })
  names(dyn_list) <- external_specs$spec_id

  cmp_list <- purrr::pmap(external_specs, function(spec_id, external_window_days, external_profile_mode, external_decay_rate) {
    run_ptw_clr_nested_model_comparison(
      clr_tbl = clr_tbl,
      ra_tbl = ra_tbl,
      metadata = metadata,
      pcr_keep = pcr_keep,
      external_window_days = external_window_days,
      external_profile_mode = external_profile_mode,
      external_decay_rate = ifelse(is.na(external_decay_rate), 0.8, external_decay_rate),
      lambda_ridge = lambda_ridge,
      title_suffix = title_base,
      min_prevalence = min_prevalence,
      min_mean_abundance = min_mean_abundance,
      prep = prep_shared,
      ...
    )
  })
  names(cmp_list) <- external_specs$spec_id

  sens_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(cmp_list, function(x, nm) {
    x$overall_summary %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  phase_sensitivity <- purrr::imap_dfr(cmp_list, function(x, nm) {
    x$phase_summary %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  support_overall <- purrr::imap_dfr(dyn_list, function(x, nm) {
    summarise_grouped_support_tbl(x$fit_tbl) %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  support_by_phase <- purrr::imap_dfr(dyn_list, function(x, nm) {
    summarise_grouped_support_tbl(x$fit_tbl, group_vars = "phase") %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  delta_ci_overall <- purrr::imap_dfr(cmp_list, function(x, nm) {
    bootstrap_nested_delta_ci(
      x$comparison_tbl,
      group_vars = NULL,
      n_boot = n_boot_ci,
      seed = seed_boot_ci + match(nm, names(cmp_list))
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  delta_ci_by_phase <- purrr::imap_dfr(cmp_list, function(x, nm) {
    bootstrap_nested_delta_ci(
      x$comparison_tbl,
      group_vars = "phase",
      n_boot = n_boot_ci,
      seed = seed_boot_ci + 100 + match(nm, names(cmp_list))
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(external_spec = nm, title_base = title_base)
  })

  list(
    dynamic = dyn_list,
    comparison = cmp_list,
    sensitivity_overall = sens_summary,
    sensitivity_by_phase = phase_sensitivity,
    support_overall = support_overall,
    support_by_phase = support_by_phase,
    delta_ci_overall = delta_ci_overall,
    delta_ci_by_phase = delta_ci_by_phase,
    external_specs = external_specs
  )
}
```

# save lean source-support results for plotting

```{r}
source_comparison_tables_25 <- lapply(
  source_suite_25$comparison,
  function(x) x$comparison_tbl
)
source_comparison_tables_35_hc <- lapply(
  source_suite_35_hc$comparison,
  function(x) x$comparison_tbl
)

res_cmp_25_overall_summary <- res_cmp_25_clr$overall_summary
res_cmp_35_overall_summary <- res_cmp_35_clr$overall_summary
res_cmp_35_hc_overall_summary <- res_cmp_35_hc_clr$overall_summary

delta_25 <- res_cmp_25_clr$comparison_tbl %>%
  select(Sample.Name, ptrap, date, phase, delta_ext_over_blank, delta_lag_over_blank) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(delta_ext_over_blank, delta_lag_over_blank),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "delta_r2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")),
    contrast = recode(
      contrast,
      delta_ext_over_blank = "External over blank",
      delta_lag_over_blank = "Lag over blank"
    ),
    dataset = "25-cycle"
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, phase, contrast, delta_r2)

res_taxon_25_feature_level <- res_taxon_25_clr$feature_level_tbl
res_taxon_35_hc_feature_level <- res_taxon_35_hc_clr$feature_level_tbl

part2_result_names <- c(
  "source_comparison_tables_25", "source_comparison_tables_35_hc",
  "res_cmp_25_overall_summary", "res_cmp_35_overall_summary",
  "res_cmp_35_hc_overall_summary", "delta_25",
  "source_sensitivity_compare_35",
  "source_phase_sensitivity_compare_35",
  "source_grouped_support_compare_35",
  "source_grouped_support_phase_compare_35",
  "source_delta_ci_compare_35_overall",
  "source_delta_ci_compare_35_by_phase",
  "source_compare_35_overall",
  "source_compare_35_phase",
  "source_compare_35_ptrap",
  "source_compare_35_delta",
  "res_taxon_25_feature_level",
  "res_taxon_35_hc_feature_level"
)

missing_part2 <- setdiff(part2_result_names, ls())
if (length(missing_part2) > 0) {
  stop("Cannot create part 2 cache; missing: ", paste(missing_part2, collapse = ", "))
}
part2_source_results <- mget(part2_result_names, inherits = FALSE)
saveRDS(part2_source_results, part2_results_file, compress = "gzip")

message("Saved part 2 source-support results to: ", part2_results_file)
```
